## canvas
- viewBox: 0 0 1280 720
- format: PPT 16:9

## mode
- mode: pyramid

## visual_style
- visual_style: data-journalism

## colors
- background: #EFE9D8
- secondary_background: #F5F1E7
- primary: #224E75
- accent: #224E75
- secondary_accent: #B52326
- body_text: #181B1D
- secondary_text: #6A6964
- divider: #C0BCAF

## typography
- title_family: Georgia, "Noto Serif SC", "Songti SC", serif
- body_family: "Songti SC", SimSun, "Noto Serif SC", serif
- font_family: "Songti SC", SimSun, "Noto Serif SC", serif
- display: 49
- title: 38
- metric: 34
- subtitle: 23
- body: 20
- annotation: 12

## icons
- library: tabler-outline
- inventory: book-2, sparkles, users, chart-bar, alert-triangle, target-arrow
- stroke_width: 1.5

## pptx_structure
- mode: flat
